integrity: Analytical proof is unrestricted in the number of blades; finite experiments are supporting checks, not external mathematical certification. Earlier work is attributed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns labelled friendship graphs with at least two blades and exactly three named colours.
Counts do not apply to larger palettes or general cactus graphs.
No closed expression for orbit counts or independently certified historical priority.
title: Strong-majority three-edge colourings of triangle windmills: complete classification and enumeration
